## Services We Offer as a Corporate MICE Travel Agency

At **House of Vacations**, we provide a comprehensive range of **Business Travel Services** designed to meet the diverse requirements of our corporate clients. Our expertise as a **Corporate Travel Agency** ensures that every aspect of your travel and event planning is handled with precision and professionalism.

### Group Travel & Retreats

We organize group tours and corporate retreats to boost employee morale, productivity, and engagement. As a leading MICE Company in India with over two decades of expertise, services include destination selection, itinerary planning, and on-site coordination to ensure a memorable experience

### Travel Risk Management

As a reputed & responsible Corporate Travel agent we prioritise safety & well being of travellers first. Our risk management solutions consist of in-depth Travel Advisory Monitoring, Destination Risk Analysis, emergency assistance, Backup Accommodations Flights & many more

### Visa & Documentation Support

Navigating through visa requirements can be a complex and time-consuming task. This is where a MICE corporate travel agency like us comes in — we provide end-to-end visa and documentation support, ensuring a hassle-free experience for your employees and guests

### 24/7 Concierge & Travel Desk

Our dedicated MICE Travel agents are all available round-the-clock to assist with bookings, itinerary changes, and any travel-related queries. As your Corporate Travel Agency, we are always available to support your needs.

### Flight, Hotel, Transport, and Logistics Booking

By leveraging our extensive network and expertise, we secure reliable bookings at the best prices for flights, accommodations, and transportation. As a leading MICE travel agency, we ensure seamless logistics coordination for all your events.


### On-Ground Execution

Our experienced team provides on-site support to manage event logistics, troubleshoot issues, and ensure smooth execution. As a reliable Corporate Travel Agent, we are committed to delivering flawless events.

### Custom Planning & Budgeting

We understand being a Corporate Travel Agency for the past 2 decades that each organization has unique objectives and budget constraints, Our MICE Travel Services include personalized planning and budgeting to align with your goals


### Logistics & Vendor Management

From venue selection to vendor negotiations, our Corporate Travel Agency handles all aspects of logistics and supplier management, ensuring cost-effective and high-quality services.

## FAQs

### Q1. What is a MICE Travel Agency?

A **MICE Travel Agency** specializes in organizing Meetings, Incentives, Conferences, and Exhibitions for corporate clients. These agencies like us  provide end-to-end solutions, including planning, logistics, and on-site management, to ensure successful business events.

### Q2. How does a Corporate MICE Company like House of Vacations work?

As a **Corporate Mice Company in India**, we collaborate closely with clients to understand their objectives and requirements. Our team then designs customized travel and event solutions, handling all aspects from planning to execution, ensuring a seamless experience.

### Q3. Can you assist with last-minute MICE changes or emergencies during business travel?

Absolutely. As a responsive **Corporate Travel Agency in India**, we provide 24/7 support to handle last-minute changes, cancellations, or emergencies, ensuring your team stays on track without disruption.

### Q4. Do you offer support for international MICE events?

Yes, as a seasoned MICE Travel Agency, we specialize in organizing international meetings, incentive trips, conferences, and exhibitions. From visa assistance to multilingual staff and venue coordination, we manage everything globally.

### Q6. What makes House of Vacations different from other Corporate MICE Companies In India ?

Our personalized approach, global network, and attention to detail set us apart as a trusted Corporate Travel Agent.
